_how_to_add: 1) Person tells Byron their nickname + XRPL wallet (and Ko-fi name, if they have one). 2) Byron adds a new key, lower-case, e.g. "cryptozeug": {"wallet": "r...", "kofi_name": "Cryptozeug", "note": "Colour Me 1st"}. 3) Save, push to GitHub, done. The site matches what the visitor types (lower-case, trimmed) to a key here, then looks up that wallet in data/holders.json.
_note: Nickname -> wallet mapping for the 'What should we call you?' box on the home page. Keys are lower-case nicknames. Byron adds real entries by hand: a person fills out the form (link to be added on index.html), Byron checks it, then adds {"wallet": "r...", "kofi_name": "...", "note": "..."} here. Never add a seed, password, or secret here — wallets only, and only with that person's permission.
